### Epic 8: E8 — Demo Hardening & Polish
- **Phase:** 4 · **Stories:** 6 (US-040 to US-045) · **Points:** 14
- **Completed:** 3/6 · **Status:** 🔄 In Progress — **US-040 set the epic's method: measure, do not
  assert.** A Playwright suite (`pnpm test:e2e`, no dependency added) drives the full run-of-show in
  real Chrome against `pnpm build` + `pnpm start` and reads the geometry jsdom answers with zeros:
  eleven viewports clean of page and in-card horizontal scroll, clipped tiles, truncated axis
  labels, SVG text outside its plot and clipped legends, with positive prompt-bar clearance and a
  mid-session resize clean both ways. It found and fixed one clipped period filter and the
  `/favicon.ico` 404 three earlier reviews had waved through. **US-041 applied the same method to
  the network:** it records every request, disconnects the browser context two ways over and runs
  the script — baseline, three heroes, three follow-ups, the sidebar link, off-script, empty submit,
  reset and a reset taken mid-beat, then all of it again under reduced motion. **Two real runtime
  fetches found and fixed at the root cause**, and the standing test now fails on any request at all
  after first paint

## Active Work

**Currently In Progress:** None — **PHASE 4 IS AT 3/6 · 7/14** with US-040, US-041 and US-042 done;
the demo script runs end to end, the screen has been measured at eleven viewports, run start to
finish **with the network severed**, and **every path a presenter can click, type or press has been
pressed** — no dead end anywhere
**Blocked Stories:** none
**Next Up:** **US-044 — brand fidelity & legibility QA (2 pts)**: crest, colours and uppercase
headers exactly per the token set, gold only on target hits and the follow-up accent, and no em or
en dashes anywhere including the score label. Eight patterns
are established for the rest of the build to copy: **a hardening claim is a measurement, not an
assertion** — US-040 takes every geometric fact from real Chrome against the built bundle with the
whole run-of-show loaded, and records an out-of-scope decision **with its numbers** in the phase
file rather than in a progress log that compacts; a
good/bad reading arrives from `derive.ts` as data and is never re-derived in a component; a recorded
review decision is expressed structurally so it cannot be reverted by accident; a shared seam is
widened rather than forked when a consumer needs slightly more (`HBarTile`'s `children`,
`DeltaChip`'s `suffix`, `CardCaption`'s `section` placement); and **pre-authored copy is rendered
verbatim** — US-024 asserts byte-identical output, which is the guarantee every Phase 3b narrative
depends on; and **a debounce is state, not a clock** — US-028 consumes the question through a
mirrored ref and closes the field on `busy`, so the only pending timer in the app is still
US-015's `schedule`; and **state that can be derived is derived** — US-029's chip row is a pure
function of `sections`, which is what closed US-015's chip criterion with no reset code at all; and
**one rule lives in one place and is pinned there by a source scan** — US-033's gate is the only
reader of `hasSection`, so gating and chip visibility can never drift into two states; and **a
breakdown must reconcile with the row it explains** — US-039's badge is summed from the rows on
screen and asserted equal to Marketing's derived variance, so the beat cannot claim to explain more
or less of the overspend than it shows
